game_title: Call Stack Tower – Wolf Watch Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch, a lookout against wolves: the snow ranger must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch: a lookout against wolves
core_gameplay_loop: In Wolf Watch, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the snow ranger ahead. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the watch bell by solving code steps involving stack_height that move the snow ranger forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the watch bell first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
